_info: Traducciones al inglés de todo lo que se ve en Tri-Sync (la web traduce al mostrar). exactos: texto completo de un nodo o atributo; patrones: [expresión regular, sustitución] para lo que lleva números o nombres. Fechas, números, dinero y países los traduce index.html.

exactos.¿Actualizar Tri-Sync ahora?\n\nSe descar:
Update Tri-Sync now?

The new version's APK is downloaded and the Android installer opens. Your settings, keys and history are not touched.

Update Tri-Sync now?

The new version is downloaded, a copy of the current one is kept in the logs folder and it restarts by itself in a few seconds. Your settings, keys and history are not touched.

exactos.Conecta solo las que uses, en cualquier: Connect only the ones you use, in any combination. Dixmax is the only one with films, series and anime: if you have it, everything is compared with it. Without Dixmax, AniList is matched with Serializd (anime series) and with Letterboxd (anime films); Letterboxd and Serializd have nothing in common (films versus series). With a single app you already get statistics.
exactos.En Configuración → Tus aplicaciones. Con: In Settings → Your apps. Connect the ones you use, in any combination; whatever you don't connect doesn't show up.
exactos.Tu historial de películas, series y anim: Your film, series and anime history. If you connect it, everything is compared with it.
exactos.Tri-Sync compara tu historial entre Dixm: Tri-Sync compares your history across Dixmax, Letterboxd, Serializd and AniList and lets you fix whatever doesn't match in one click.
exactos.Conecta las que uses: con una ya tienes: Connect the ones you use: with one you already get statistics; with two or more, it also compares them.
exactos.Con estas apps no hay nada que comparar: Nothing to compare with these apps
exactos.Letterboxd lleva películas y Serializd s: Letterboxd has films and Serializd has series: they have nothing in common. Connect Dixmax or AniList to review; statistics still work with what you have.

exactos.Letterboxd: buscando el id de TMDB de: Letterboxd: looking up the TMDB id of

exactos.Junta en los dos sentidos tus ajustes, r: Merges your settings, rules, cache, history and the newest export of each site both ways. If you change the same thing on both, the most recent change wins. It never goes through the internet.
exactos.Android conectado por cable, con la depu: Android connected by cable, with USB debugging on. If a newer version is built here, it installs it.
exactos.Uno espera y el otro escribe la direcció: One waits and the other types in the address and code it shows. Best: the phone waits and the PC connects. It's encrypted with the code, which only works for those 2 minutes; 5 wrong attempts close it. Use it on your home Wi-Fi, not on public networks.

exactos.No veo ningún móvil: conéctalo por USB c: I can't see any phone: connect it by USB with USB debugging on and accept the prompt
